verses.original: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν Πάτερ ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα δόξασόν σου τὸν Υἱόν ἵνα ὁ Υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ
verses.transliteration: Tauta elalēsen Iēsous kai eparas tous ophthalmous autou eis ton ouranon eipen Pater elēlythen hē hōra doxason sou ton Huion hina ho Huios doxasē se
verses.literal: When Jesus had spoken these things He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said Father the hour has come Glorify Your Son that Your Son may glorify You

verses.original: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: kathōs edōkas autō exousian pasēs sarkos hina pan ho dedōkas autō dōsē autois zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: For You granted Him authority over all people so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him

verses.original: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν Θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: hautē de estin hē aiōnios zōē hina ginōskōsin se ton monon alēthinon Theon kai hon apesteilas Iēsoun Christon
verses.literal: Now this is eternal life that they may know You the only true God and Jesus Christ whom You have sent

verses.original: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω
verses.transliteration: egō se edoxasa epi tēs gēs to ergon teleiōsas ho dedōkas moi hina poiēsō
verses.literal: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do

verses.original: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ Πάτερ παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί
verses.transliteration: kai nyn doxason me sy Pater para seautō tē doxē hē eichon pro tou ton kosmon einai para soi
verses.literal: And now Father glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed

verses.original: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ἔδωκας καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν
verses.transliteration: Ephanerōsa sou to onoma tois anthrōpois hous edōkas moi ek tou kosmou soi ēsan kamoi autous edōkas kai ton logon sou tetērēkan
verses.literal: I have revealed Your name to those . . . . . . You have given Me out of the world They were Yours You gave them to Me and they have kept Your word

verses.original: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: nyn egnōkan hoti panta hosa dedōkas moi para sou eisin
verses.literal: Now they know that everything . . . You have given Me comes from You

verses.original: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας
verses.transliteration: hoti ta rhēmata ha edōkas moi dedōka autois kai autoi elabon kai egnōsan alēthōs hoti para sou exēlthon kai episteusan hoti sy me apesteilas
verses.literal: For I have given them the words You gave Me and they have received them They knew with certainty that I came from You and they believed that You sent Me

verses.original: Ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι σοί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: Egō peri autōn erōtō ou peri tou kosmou erōtō alla peri hōn dedōkas moi hoti soi eisin
verses.literal: I ask on their behalf I do not ask on behalf of the world but on behalf of those You have given Me for they are Yours

verses.original: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ta ema panta sa estin kai ta sa ema kai dedoxasmai en autois
verses.literal: All I have is Yours and all You have is Mine and in them I have been glorified

verses.original: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι Πάτερ ἅγιε τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ouketi eimi en tō kosmō kai autoi en tō kosmō eisin kagō pros se erchomai Pater hagie tērēson autous en tō onomati sou hō dedōkas moi hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis
verses.literal: I will no longer be . . . in the world but they are in the world and I am coming to You Holy Father protect them by Your name the name You gave Me so that they may be one as We are one

verses.original: ὅτε ἤμην μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι καὶ ἐφύλαξα καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: hote ēmēn met’ autōn egō etēroun autous en tō onomati sou hō dedōkas moi kai ephylaxa kai oudeis ex autōn apōleto ei mē ho huios tēs apōleias hina hē graphē plērōthē
verses.literal: While I was with them I protected and preserved them by Your name the name You gave Me Not one of them has been lost except . . . the son of destruction so that the Scripture would be fulfilled

verses.original: Νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Nyn de pros se erchomai kai tauta lalō en tō kosmō hina echōsin tēn charan tēn emēn peplērōmenēn en heautois
verses.literal: But now I am coming to You and I am saying these things while I am in the world so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them

verses.original: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: egō dedōka autois ton logon sou kai ho kosmos emisēsen autous hoti ouk eisin ek tou kosmou kathōs egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them For they are not of the world just as I am not of the world

verses.original: Οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ’ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouk erōtō hina arēs autous ek tou kosmou all’ hina tērēsēs autous ek tou ponērou
verses.literal: I am not asking that You take them out of the world but that You keep them from the evil one

verses.original: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: ek tou kosmou ouk eisin kathōs egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: They are not of the world just as I am not of the world

verses.original: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: hagiason autous en tē alētheia ho logos ho sos alētheia estin
verses.literal: Sanctify them by the truth Your word is truth

verses.original: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: kathōs eme apesteilas eis ton kosmon kagō apesteila autous eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: As You sent Me into the world I have also sent them into the world

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai hyper autōn egō hagiazō emauton hina ōsin kai autoi hēgiasmenoi en alētheia
verses.literal: For them I sanctify Myself so that they too may be sanctified by the truth

verses.original: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: Ou peri toutōn de erōtō monon alla kai peri tōn pisteuontōn dia tou logou autōn eis eme
verses.literal: I am not asking on behalf of them alone but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message

verses.original: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν καθὼς σύ πάτερ ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας
verses.transliteration: hina pantes hen ōsin kathōs sy pater en emoi kagō en soi hina kai autoi en hēmin ōsin hina ho kosmos pisteuē hoti sy me apesteilas
verses.literal: that all of them may be one as You Father are in Me and I am in You May they also be in Us so that the world may believe that You sent Me

verses.original: Κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν
verses.transliteration: Kagō tēn doxan hēn dedōkas moi dedōka autois hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis hen
verses.literal: I have given them the glory You gave Me so that they may be one as We are one

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας
verses.transliteration: egō en autois kai sy en emoi hina ōsin teteleiōmenoi eis hen hina ginōskē ho kosmos hoti sy me apesteilas kai ēgapēsas autous kathōs eme ēgapēsas
verses.literal: I in them and You in Me that they may be perfectly united so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me

verses.original: Πάτερ ὃ δέδωκάς μοι θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Pater ho dedōkas moi thelō hina hopou eimi egō kakeinoi ōsin met’ emou hina theōrōsin tēn doxan tēn emēn hēn dedōkas moi hoti ēgapēsas me pro katabolēs kosmou
verses.literal: Father I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world

verses.original: Πάτερ δίκαιε καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας
verses.transliteration: Pater dikaie kai ho kosmos se ouk egnō egō de se egnōn kai houtoi egnōsan hoti sy me apesteilas
verses.literal: Righteous Father although the world has not known You I know You and they know that You sent Me

verses.original: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egnōrisa autois to onoma sou kai gnōrisō hina hē agapē hēn ēgapēsas me en autois ē kagō en autois
verses.literal: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known so that the love You have for . . . Me may be in them and I in them
